g.text: Both passes and both entropy checks now share a physical fault domain.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526172

g.text: Sharing overhead, persistent-fault coverage and timing remain unvalidated.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526172

g.text: Planning point: 0.018 µm²/GE · 0.0225 µm²/SRAM bit · logic ×1.25 / 62.5% utilization

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526172

g.text: SRAM macro = bitcell floor ×2.25. One physical SHA core; all existing framing, scratch and checking retained.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b4d

g.text: NOT SIZED: OTP (272 bytes), physical entropy sources, timing references/sensors, pads/ESD, power/DFT, and the protected application processor.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b4d

g.text: NOT INCLUDED: new arbitration, ownership/tag checks, context clearing, routing and any extra fault detection. Production RTL is unchanged.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526172

g.text: Estimate = measured nine-core baseline − 8 × 21.0167 kGE bare compressors. No claim of equivalent timing or fault protection.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #526172
